QUOTE: **Compile-time substitution:** define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`. ... **Runtime substitution:** define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` without the two macros.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. Defining the runtime option "without the two macros", and the macros omitting the runtime code in `platform.c`, shows they are mutually exclusive.
